prompt:
The snippet snippets/membership-renewal.liquid is broken: it does not parse and its logic is incomplete. Rewrite it so it parses under strict Liquid and renders a membership renewal reminder. Inputs (all top-level, always supplied): - `member`: object or null. When non-null it always has these keys: - `member.name`: string or null - `member.plan`: string, never null - `member.days_left`: integer or null. Negative means the membership already expired. - `member.auto_renew`: boolean Rules: 1. Output nothing (empty string) if `member` is null, if `member.days_left` is null, or if `member.days_left` is greater than 30. 2. STATE is `expired` when days_left < 0, `today` when days_left == 0, and `soon` when days_left is 1..30. 3. N is the absolute value of days_left. UNIT is `day` when N is 1, otherwise `days`. 4. VERB is `renews` when auto_renew is true, otherwise `expires`. 5. Output exactly, with no whitespace between or around tags and no leading or trailing whitespace: `

GREETING SENTENCE

LINK
` - GREETING: if name, after stripping surrounding whitespace, is non-empty, output `Hi NAME, ` (the stripped name, HTML-escaped with the escape filter, followed by exactly one space). Otherwise output nothing (no space either). - SENTENCE: expired: `Your PLAN membership expired N UNIT ago.`; today: `Your PLAN membership VERB today.`; soon: `Your PLAN membership VERB in N UNIT.` PLAN is HTML-escaped with the escape filter. - LINK: `Renew now` when STATE is expired (regardless of auto_renew) or when auto_renew is false. Otherwise nothing. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/membership-renewal.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
